hunks.added: ChatGPT (OpenAI), also an AI system and not an author, reviewed versions 1 to 7 of this paper in turn: it checked the record hashes, independently recomputed the revised statistics, and reported errors, each of which was verified against the files and corrected where confirmed (Appendix F).

Version 8 (October 27, 2026; this paper) answers a seventh review, which found no actionable defect (RESPONSE-TO-REVIEW-7.md; no experiment was run and no number changed). It carries two changes ordered by the author: his official name, Anthony DeMarco, replaces the name printed in versions 1 to 7, and the contribution statement credits ChatGPT’s reviews.
